judge.rationale: The candidate only finished the test-setup / TDD red phase and never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block. Because the production code is unchanged, the new tests in `src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately. Additionally, while the candidate added a line to `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, it failed to remove the old recorded-flaw bullet under 'Measured semantics — out of scope' and did not explain what `afterSession` can assume about how much of the turn happened. Finally, `CHANGELOG.md` was not updated at all, and an unrequested `.lore/dod.md` file was left in the diff.
